name: Tip selector
description: No tip, 10%, 15% or 20% of the cart, added to the order's total.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/tip-selector", name: "Tip selector", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "No tip, 10%, 15% or 20% of the cart, added to the order's total.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Text(child: "Add a tip for the team", weight: FontWeight.semibold),
      Row(gap: Space.sm, children: [
        Expanded(child: Box(padding: Insets(y: 10), radius: Radius.md, alignment: Anchor.center, background: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 0 / 100) ? Color.primary : Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), onTap: SetTip(percent: 0), ariaLabel: "No tip", child: Text(child: "None", weight: FontWeight.semibold, color: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 0 / 100) ? Color.primaryInk : Color.text))),
        Expanded(child: Box(padding: Insets(y: 10), radius: Radius.md, alignment: Anchor.center, background: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 10 / 100) ? Color.primary : Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), onTap: SetTip(percent: 10), ariaLabel: "Ten percent", child: Text(child: "10%", weight: FontWeight.semibold, color: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 10 / 100) ? Color.primaryInk : Color.text))),
        Expanded(child: Box(padding: Insets(y: 10), radius: Radius.md, alignment: Anchor.center, background: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 15 / 100) ? Color.primary : Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), onTap: SetTip(percent: 15), ariaLabel: "Fifteen percent", child: Text(child: "15%", weight: FontWeight.semibold, color: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 15 / 100) ? Color.primaryInk : Color.text))),
        Expanded(child: Box(padding: Insets(y: 10), radius: Radius.md, alignment: Anchor.center, background: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 20 / 100) ? Color.primary : Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), onTap: SetTip(percent: 20), ariaLabel: "Twenty percent", child: Text(child: "20%", weight: FontWeight.semibold, color: checkout.tip_cents == round(cart.total_cents * 20 / 100) ? Color.primaryInk : Color.text)))
      ]),
      Text(child: "Tip: ${formatMoney(checkout.tip_cents)}", size: FontSize.sm, color: Color.textMuted)
    ])
  )], data: [Data(name: "checkout", from: Client.checkout(), fetch: "client", type: ClientCheckout), Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart)],
)
